context: The core sweep. Tests deduplication across three distinct axes (already applied, cross-posted, previously seen), that blockers are dropped with a recorded reason rather than deleted, that no ranking column is introduced, and that the CSV survives a real parser. A pipeline that loses history or silently drops rows cannot be trusted on the next run.

checklist.name: Reconciled against the log first
checklist.description: Reconciled the pipeline against applications/log.csv before evaluating newly harvested jobs, rather than harvesting first and filtering afterwards

checklist.name: Swept every configured source
checklist.description: Visited each of the LinkedIn, Ashby, and Greenhouse fixture boards

checklist.name: Already-applied role marked applied
checklist.description: A role that already appears in applications/log.csv has status applied and a populated applied_date, not new

checklist.name: Cross-post collapsed to one row
checklist.description: The job cross-posted to both LinkedIn and Ashby produced exactly one row, not two

checklist.name: Second URL preserved
checklist.description: That merged row carries the second URL in its notes column, in the form 'also: <url>'

checklist.name: Previously seen row kept its history
checklist.description: The row that already existed in pipeline.csv kept its original first_seen and its existing status, rather than being reset to new, and had only last_seen bumped to the run date

checklist.name: Work-authorization blocker dropped
checklist.description: The posting requiring US work authorization has status dropped with drop_reason us-work-auth

checklist.name: Junior role dropped
checklist.description: The junior or intern-level posting has status dropped with drop_reason junior-ic

checklist.name: Drops retained, not deleted
checklist.description: Dropped rows are still present in pipeline.csv rather than removed from it, so the next run can see what was already ruled out

checklist.name: No ranking column
checklist.description: pipeline.csv contains no column named score, fit, rank, match, or any equivalent numeric ranking. The user's stated position is that anything with a genuine similarity is worth applying to

checklist.name: CSV is well formed
checklist.description: Every data row parses to exactly 16 fields with a standard CSV parser, including any row whose role contains a comma, and every row has a non-empty job_key

checklist.name: Run report written
checklist.description: A run report was written under search/runs/, and it counts the dropped rows by reason

checklist.name: One task space for the sweep
checklist.description: Drove the browser through ego-browser using a single task space for the whole sweep rather than one per source

checklist.name: Did not touch the application side
checklist.description: Nothing was written to applications/, cv/, or qa/
